asvspoof2019.description: ASVspoof2019 LA evaluation partition -- the same corpus AASIST was trained on. Used to fit calibration; measures in-distribution performance, not generalisation.

asvspoof2021.description: ASVspoof2021 DF (speech deepfake track) evaluation partition -- different attack algorithms and lossy-codec conditions than 2019. Held out entirely for reporting.
